source_reproducibility_report.method: Fresh extraction of final Source ZIP, npm ci locked workflow using shared download cache, full production build including TypeScript/prerender/verifier, exhaustive byte/hash comparison with reviewed production manifest.

final_package_hygiene.limitations: Scoped known-file/limited secret-pattern hygiene and exhaustive byte integrity checks. Does not certify all possible privacy, permissions or provenance questions; owner item HOLDs persist.

portrait.policy: Exact original preserved; proportional downsampling and WebP compression only. CSS masks are non-destructive. Owner approval establishes publication identity, not independent photographic provenance.

approved_brand.basis: Newest owner brand-restoration instruction; archived LOGO_EVALUATION.md v4.1 and preserved earlier Header/Footer references

assets.mask_method: Manually authored source-coordinate SVG alpha polygons; same supplied pixels on intact base and masked duplicates. No generative edits, no depth-estimation claim, no hidden-surface reconstruction.
assets.provenance_limits: C scenes remain labeled conceptual/edited; B maintenance/field remain unconfirmed. Zazi current road/culvert illustration is not verified named-bridge photography. No generative reconstruction performed by mask generator.
